description: This file contains the implementation of Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker, a class that provides hash selection logic for Orleans v3 to v7+ migration scenarios. It implements the IStorageHasherPicker interface and includes methods for picking hashers based on grain IDs and types.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker
classes.description: A hash picker implementation compatible with Orleans v3 for migration to v7+.

methods.name: Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the hash picker with a non-string hasher.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Selects an appropriate hasher based on grain ID and type, with special handling for integer and GUID keys.
